plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Maritime Studies (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] Required the first semester in the MAST program.
[grid1 fn3] Select from ANTH 202 , ANTH 313 , ANTH 350 , ANTH 409 , ANTH 423 , ANTH 485 ; COMM 203 , COMM 365/JOUR 365 ; ENGL 330 , ENGL 334 , ENGL 338 , ENGL 339/AFST 339 , ENGL 374/WGST 374 , ENGL 484 , ENGL 485 ; HIST 226 , HIST 370 , HIST 373 , HIST 374 , HIST 405 , HIST 485 ; KINE 199 ; MARA 212 , MARA 421 , MARA 435 , MARA 470 ; POLS 353 , POLS 366 ; SPAN 101 , SPAN 102 , SPAN 201 , SPAN 202 . A maximum of 3 hours of KINE 199 , and a maximum of 3 hours of 484 or 485 may be used for directed electives.
